source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Unresolved: verify non-destructive image browsing/selection, stage an image across reboot, or initiate a firmware update. The generic default-setting procedure does not define which lifecycle the item requires.
original_method: The item names firmware image selection, while Procedure/Criteria require changing an unspecified setting, saving/rebooting, verifying persistence and loading defaults. Those operations do not establish target/image validation or whether selection commits a write.
manual_activity: After correction, an engineer must navigate the firmware picker and verify the displayed target/image identity; any staging or update commit requires separately defined approval. No selection is authorized under the current ambiguous lifecycle.
required_inputs: Owner decision: browse/cancel, selection-only, persistent staging, or update commit
Target component and current/source/target firmware identities
Vendor-approved image, release notes, board compatibility, digest and signature
Exact picker behavior, cancel/commit trigger, pending-state and reboot semantics
Stable power, independent console/OOB, configuration backup and rollback/recovery
safety_requirements: Do not operationalize all/random, select arbitrary media or invoke Update/Flash under this ambiguous case.
Verify board/product/component compatibility, signature and digest before the UI opens any image.
Treat a picker selection as potentially stateful until vendor behavior proves cancel/no-commit semantics.
Use stable power and an independent recovery package/path even for staging workflows.
Stop on wrong target/image, unexpected flash/pending state, inability to cancel, boot or management degradation.
agent_execution_scope: Before correction, preserve source conflict and required identity/recovery analysis only.
After correction, collect read-only firmware/BMC identity, public image metadata/digest, update/pending state, audit logs and boot/management health around operator actions.
Do not drive BIOS, select files, mount unapproved media, stage/flash firmware or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Resolve the intended lifecycle and align Items, Procedure and Criteria.
Approve target/image/provenance, picker semantics, commit boundary, power and recovery; perform the corrected UI workflow.
Interpret identity/update-state evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its manual-boundary conclusion is valid, but the proposed generic save/reboot/default sequence does not test image selection and could cross an undefined update boundary.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No executable method is recommended until lifecycle correction. A selection-only method must explicitly exit/cancel without commit and confirm unchanged firmware and no pending update.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The null script and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; they do not resolve the selection/update lifecycle.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: If selection-only, validate picker filtering, target, filename/version, digest/signature display, cancel/no-commit and unchanged pending/version state. If staging/update is intended, define it as a separate signed, stable-power update lifecycle with activation and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact firmware picker, target component and vendor image after owner correction.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC/update-engine and image versions plus digest/signature verifier version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor firmware picker/update and recovery documentation for the exact platform.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces generic setting persistence with explicit selection, staging and commit boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents accidental firmware writes; final coverage depends on the chosen lifecycle.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Lifecycle, target, image, picker semantics, commit boundary and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: UI selection may create hidden pending state even without an immediate flash; read-only post-checks are required.

project_override_considerations: A project may define a verified selection-only or update workflow, but it must record the exact lifecycle and cannot silently convert this master case or claim update coverage from picker evidence.
expected_evidence: Owner-approved corrected lifecycle and aligned procedure/criteria
Target/platform identity, approved image digest/signature/compatibility and recovery
Operator picker captures showing exact image/target and commit/cancel boundary
Firmware version and pending/update state before and after
Boot/management health, final state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item is an image-selection function, while the source Procedure and Criteria describe an unnamed persistent BIOS setting and Load Default. They do not define whether selection is transient, staged or an update commit, so the core operation and expected result conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The ambiguity crosses a destructive firmware-write boundary. Supplying a project image alone cannot determine whether the case must cancel, stage or flash, so owner correction is required.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its manual UI boundary but rejects its generic settings lifecycle.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Uses its selection-only method as a possible corrected branch, not as authority to overwrite the original ambiguous source.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Preserves original facts and blocks at the exact commit-boundary ambiguity instead of assuming a safe scope.

review_improvement: Prevents a file-picker test from silently triggering a firmware write and separates image provenance, selection, staging and activation evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Selection-only and update workflows have materially different risk and acceptance. Because the source does not establish which one is intended, execution is genuinely unsafe and BLOCKED.
no_automatic_retry: No selection, staging, update or retry is authorized before lifecycle correction; afterward preserve first picker, pending-state, update, boot or management anomaly and obtain engineer disposition.

active_blocked_analysis.analysis: The approved ruling resolves the review-level ambiguity; remaining package, SPEC, parameter, environment, approval and recovery facts are execution-readiness inputs.
